posts.name: redlife000
posts.cooked:
Hello all,

I made it through all the videos of the Sentinel Comics RPG, and absolutely can't wait to play this game. I've been playing since 2012, and have participated in every sentinels related Kickstarter/Preorder/Patreon since. However, in the chat, it was mentioned that chapter 2, character creation, would be at Gen Con, which unfortunately I can't attend due to having just started a new job, and then on the Playtesting forums. So, my question is, where are those forums/what would it take to access those forums? Or is this a thing where if I can't make it, I just can't see it until January.

Thank you for any help, and as a side note, I'd certainly be willing to throw dollars to them as well, if I have missed the option to become a playtester somewhere, like some other RPG centric companies have.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
I might have mis-typed in the chat, so I wanted to clarify here! This does in fact refer to chapters of the Core Rulebook, which is currently being refined and edited and laid out (which is quite an extensive process). The chapters are:

  1. Introduction
  2. Playing the Game
  3. Creating Heroes
  4. Running the Game
  5. The Bullpen <- (creating GM elements)
  6. Adventure Issues <- (2 premade adventures)
  7. The Archives <- (premade heroes/villains/minions/environments/etc)

We are hoping to have Chapter 3 at Gen Con, and to run some stuff from Chapter 6.
